CustomField.description: FSD 5.10.5 rate variance: the change in unit rate valued at the CURRENT consumption. It isolates how much of the dollar change was caused by price, holding usage constant. Together with usage variance it accounts for the whole change.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How much of the change versus last month came from a change in price, at this month volume. A positive number means the provider charged more per unit. Blank on a first bill or where last month consumption was zero.
CustomField.label: Rate Variance
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(Prior_Utility_Bill__c), Prior_Utility_Bill__r.Consumption__c = 0 ), null, Total_Charges_Amount__c - ( Prior_Utility_Bill__r.Total_Charges_Amount__c / Prior_Utility_Bill__r.Consumption__c ) * Consumption__c )
